name: decompose-over-cap
why: Four subproblems against a cap of two: the cap was in the request's own schema, so exceeding it is a schema failure rather than something to silently trim.

provenance.why_not_recorded: The API cannot be asked to violate the `maxItems` constraint it was constrained by, so this body models the response the schema forbids in order to prove the second check — the one in `parse_subproblems` — is real rather than decorative.
